title: ACS Typed Handoff
description: Typed handoff payload passed between ACS roles (Planner, Generator, Evaluator). Formalizes principle #7 (handoffs as first-class typed primitives, not free-form prose) and #4 (cross-role state lives on disk, not in a shared context window).

kind.description: plan = Planner sets the contract; submission = Generator hands an artifact; verdict = Evaluator accepts or rejects.

artifact_ref.description: Path to the artifact on disk. State on disk, never passed in a shared context window.

contract.description: The criteria the artifact is graded against. The Evaluator grades against this, not the upstream prose (principle #5).

provenance.description: Who produced this handoff. Distinct session and model per role is what makes the Evaluator structurally unable to rubber-stamp the Generator (principle #2).
